slides.title: What I do in the weird week between Christmas and New Year
slides.sub: No, it's not a deep clean

slides.title: One box for gift packaging
slides.body: Boxes, tissue, bags all go into one box. Recycle or keep, decided once.

slides.title: Give each new gift a home
slides.body: Five minutes per room. If it has no home, something old makes room.

slides.title: Take down one thing a day
slides.body: Decor comes down a little at a time, not in one exhausting Sunday.

slides.title: Clear the fridge of leftovers
slides.body: Eat, freeze or toss. Starting January with a clean fridge feels so good.

slides.title: Write next year's 'note to self'
slides.body: What worked, what didn't. Tape it inside the decor bin for next year.

slides.title: Rest counts too. This week is for slowing down, not catching up.
Want a fresh start for January?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.

caption:
